notes: INSIDE half of the Laser Mk1 (hull mount, outward = up; the top flange overhangs the inner wall face, see offset): cell bank, repair hatch, power coupling, 5-cell charge strip. charge: frame round(fraction*5); frame 5 = ready (all green); fire: the strip discharges (flash, then dark). damaged: last cells dead, a cell cracked, sparks; disabled: dark, cracked. The rotating head is laser_mk1_barrel (idle, fire, damaged, disabled).
